g.text: Split CIFAR-10: does saved-route access recover retained skills?
Same final model weights within each arm; all ten output classes remain eligible. Hatched bars use test labels diagnostically.
Three seed means, each averaging two task orders; bars show seed SD. Known training boundaries used for route archives and context learning.
